subject: Essential Mathematics
title: Commercial Arithmetic (1)
verified_by: Codex visual inspection of original local PDF rendering, 2026-11-12

outcomes.text: prepare budget to for use in clubs or societies,
calculate discount and percentage discounts in different situations,
determine commission and percentage commissions in the different situations
determine percentage profit and loss made in the sale of goods,
convert currencies using exchange rates tables,
recognise the role of commercial arithmetic in day-to-day life.

inquiry_questions: Why do we need a budget?
Why are discounts and commissions necessary in trading activities?
notes: The visible selected sub-strand table does not state a lesson allocation; blueprint duration is a pilot design decision, not an official allocation.
Outcome a contains the source typo “to for”; preserved in the curriculum record, interpreted as preparing a usable club budget.
coreCompetencies:
Citizenship: The learner develops ethical and digital citizenship skills when obtaining digital or printed currency exchange rates charts/tables, and working out currency conversion from Kenya Shillings to any other currencies.
Critical thinking and problem solving: The learner acquires interpretation and inference skills when role play shopping scenarios where discounts are given and work out the discounts and the percentage discount.
values:
Peace: the learner respects self and others by listening to others’ opinion while brainstorming brainstorm scenarios under which commissions are paid to salespersons for sale of goods and services.
Patriotism: the learner displays loyalty by showing love for one's own country's currency when obtaining digital or printed currency exchange rates tables and working out currency conversion from Kenya Shillings to any other currencies.
pcis: Financial literacy: the learner’s financial skills are enhanced when obtaining digital or printed currency exchange rates charts/tables, and working out currency conversion from Kenya Shillings to any other currencies.
